author: edwong57
body:
Dear all, 

The proposal has been made to obsolete GO:0009107 lipoate biosynthetic process
and merged to GO:0009249 protein lipoylation 
see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/32418

Experimental annotations that need to be reviewed are here: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Cl-vmLcSU88aFtfCh4-Iy54fF7AcrRUfs2tITzf6IkM/edit?usp=sharing

Impacted groups: 

EcoliWiki | 2
~FlyBase | 2~ DONE
MGI | 1 - automatically fixed in Noctua
MTBBASE | 1
SGD | 1 - automatically fixed in Noctua
TIGR | 1
UniProt | 6



** Group contacts: https://github.com/geneontology/go-site/blob/master/metadata/group-contacts.csv
----

Mappings that need to be reviewed: (InterPro2GO, UniProt-Keywords, UniRule)

Thanks.
